storyline.real: After a late safety car Hamilton pits for soft tyres, collides with Albon on the penultimate lap and loses second to Gasly by 0.062 seconds at the line; a time penalty then drops him to seventh.
storyline.headline: No photo finish this time: Hamilton beats Gasly to the line at Interlagos

mastery.label: Beat Gasly on three more stops, as Hamilton made

eras.briefing: Interlagos, 2019. Verstappen starts from pole with Hamilton third; Gasly's Toro Rosso is sixth on the grid.
